claim: The exact matching original 8,171,008-byte DLL-001 AnmBankData static constructor .cctor MethodDef 0x06005246 has 25-byte IL SHA fbb695a6ddc0ccb80cf02a59b0d1761abec6590b352227e72fef7665be148393. It creates an original 120x2 int32 array, duplicates the object, loads the original <PrivateImplementationDetails> FieldDef 0x0400B8F6 token, invokes original RuntimeHelpers.InitializeArray MemberRef 0x0A0001E5, and stores the initialized array into original AnmBankData.FileNumTbl FieldDef 0x0400656D. The exact FieldRVA metadata table 29 row 507 binds FieldDef 0x0400B8F6 to RVA 0x007B32C0 (file offset 0x007AFEC0), where the matching original DLL has 960 source bytes SHA 107e6a82ea8141420999dbb5c61ed597cdcb4d9cc74c941b1153ec5bd5ed215b. The source bytes decode into exactly 120 distinct (bank ID,file count) int32 pairs in original source order: 78 bank IDs map to 1, 28 map to 2 and 14 map to 3. Every pair is preserved in the witness, and the source verifier reconstructs and checks all 960 bytes. This completes original DLL static input values for the previously proven GetAnmFileNum lookup FACT-0290; it does not prove any external Unity resource, animation pixels, transition timing or actual runtime loading.

limits: These 120 original signed 32-bit source pairs prove the static array initialization and bank lookup inputs of the matching retail DLL; they do not prove that a particular Unity TextAsset is present or successfully loaded in a retail session.
GetAnmFileNum's original unmatched-bank fallback remains 1; an absent bank key is not evidence that authored animation resources exist for it.

Original FieldRVA storage and System.Runtime.CompilerServices.RuntimeHelpers.InitializeArray call prove source data and wiring; actual runtime initialization, resource availability, authored motion data, bank transformations and playback timing remain separate verification gates.
